sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Off-Price Wholesale Liquidation of Branded Overstock Apparel

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (with hybrid elements derived from EU directives and treaty law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg–United States Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (DTAA, 1996, as amended by 2009 Protocol)
Luxembourg–United Kingdom Double Taxation Arrangement (1967, as amended)
EU–United Kingdom Trade and Cooperation Agreement (2021)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Luxembourg Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended; Luxembourg Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE) and its implementing regulations; Luxembourg Law of 25 March 2020 on administrative cooperation in tax matters, as amended; CSSF Circular 18/698 on AML/CFT; CSSF Regulation 12-02; Criminal Code Articles 135-8 to 135-16.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Existence from the foreign company registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Registry of the Country of Origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Registry of the Country of Origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association of any corporate shareholder/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or Company Registry in the Country of Origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or National Identity Card of each natural person UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Issuing Authority in the Country of Origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of Residential Address of each natural person UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local Municipality or Public Utility Provider

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory automated and manual screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, shareholders, and authorized signatories against the Luxembourg consolidated national list, UN Security Council sanctions lists, EU targeted financial sanctions list (EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions File), OFAC SDN/SSI lists, and publicly available PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence is required for PEPs, PEP-related persons, and entities having commercial links to high-risk third jurisdictions as defined by FATF. Screening results must be documented in the AML file, retained for at least five years after the business relationship ends, and reported to the Luxembourg FIU in case of a positive match, false-positive disputes, or suspicious transaction indicators.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés / RCS Online
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be submitted to the RCS in one of the administrative languages of Luxembourg (principally French; German and Luxembourgish are also generally accepted). The name must be in Latin script and transliterated using standard Latin characters without diacritical marks if used for international transborder purposes. The name must be legible, distinctive, and not create confusion with existing RCS-registered legal entities. The corporate form 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' or 'SARL' must appear as a legal form identifier; a sole-shareholder SARL must include the suffix 'SARL', and the name may include 'société anonyme' equivalents only if the actual legal form is accordingly registered.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a negative name reservation decision issued by the RCS via the LBR portal, the applicant or its Luxembourg counsel may file a written administrative appeal with the RCS within 15 days of notification. The appeal must include the proposed name, the RCS reference, the facts, and legal arguments showing distinctiveness and absence of public-policy conflict. If the RCS maintains the refusal, the applicant may seek annulment before the administrative tribunal of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg (Tribunal Administratif) within 60 days of the administrative appeal decision. During the appeal, no name reservation extension is available; the applicant may file a new name reservation application with a revised or alternative proposed name at any time.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office (i.e., mail forwarding with no physical presence in Luxembourg) is not permissible for a SARL. The registered office must be a physical, identifiable, and accessible location in Luxembourg. Use of a corporate service provider is permissible only if the service provider maintains an active physical office, provides local administrative presence, receives and genuinely reviews official correspondence, and allows access to the registered office during business hours. The registered office must appear in the RCS and must coincide with the actual seat real administration for tax purposes, unless an administrative co-location arrangement is formally disclosed to the Luxembourg tax administration.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 15–20% cumulative probability within the first 12 months after incorporation for cross-border, non-resident-managed wholesale trading entities. The Luxembourg Registry of Commerce, the Tax Administration, and the Luxembourg Financial Intelligence Unit may perform unannounced physical on-site inspections to verify that the registered office is real, occupied, and capable of receiving process and official notifications. Documentation regarding the physical office, lease or sub-lease agreement, and local management authority must be maintained on site.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Luxembourg notarial deed of incorporation for a single-founder SARL (minimum notarial fee and publication of deed extracts)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff as set by the Chamber of Notaries, plus fixed ministerial and account fees.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and RCS registration filing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official LBR fee schedule, current administrative tariff for online filing of new company registration.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of incorporation notice in the Official Electronic Gazette (Recueil Électronique des Sociétés)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed official gazette publication tariff as prescribed by ministerial regulation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE) initial filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed RBE filing fee published by LBR; no notarial fee required where the incorporation deed notary supplies data.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT customer due diligence file, PEP/sanctions screening, and UBO identification external legal counsel package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for pre-incorporation legal counsel in Luxembourg for customary AML/CFT due diligence, international apostille review, and privilege-bounded compliance advice.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization or apostille verification for foreign UBO and shareholder documentation (average 6 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg Embassy/Consulate / Apostille competent authority in the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular legalization fee schedules and apostille certificate tariffs, varying by country of issuance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office agreement with a Luxembourg administrative service provider (physical office, mail handling, process-agent capacity) for one year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Luxembourg administrative service provider (société fiduciaire or registered office provider)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a full administrative office package and domiciliation agreement in Luxembourg.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Translation and certified translation of foreign registry documents into French or English where required
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory or market per-page benchmark for certified translations used in RCS filings and notarial incorporation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency reserve for administrative re-submissions, extended UBO verification, and bank/AML documentation fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Risk-based contingency benchmark equal to approximately 12% of total pre-incorporation professional fees.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Amended Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies (Loi modifiée du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales), Articles 710-1 to 710-24 (SARL), as amended by the Law of 19 July 2013
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés – RCS), independent service of the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Articles of Association (Statuts authentiques), RCS e-filing Form C, and mandatory publication in the electronic gazette Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum subscribed share capital EUR 12,000; each share must be paid up to at least 20% of its nominal value (share premium 100%) at incorporation; cash contributions must be deposited in a blocked escrow account (compte bloqué) with a Luxembourg credit institution in the name of the company in formation, released solely against the RCS registration certificate; in-kind contributions require a report by an independent statutory auditor (réviseur d'entreprises)
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers, having signed the Articles of Association of the company, hereby confirm the subscription of the minimum share capital of EUR 12,000 and the lawful payment of the statutory portion thereof as deposited in the blocked escrow account; that the registered office of the company is fixed and maintained at [Street Address], L-[postcode] Luxembourg; that [Name] is appointed sole manager (gérant) with full powers to represent the company, open bank accounts and execute all commercial acts; and that the manager is directed to complete RCS registration, RESA publication, VAT, EORI, social security and municipal occupational filings necessary for the company's legal formation and commencement of wholesale apparel liquidation trading.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Availability Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) portal operated under the aegis of the RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify the proposed corporate name against the LBR online database and trademark files; submit and pay the name reservation application electronically or before the clerk of the District Court; the reserved name is valid for one year and must match the name used in the future notarial deed.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application (LBR online form)
Identity documents of founding shareholders and managers
Short statement of corporate purpose (objet social) in French or German
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If refused or queried on similarity grounds, file a corrected reserve request with a distinct sign and, exceptionally, seek judicial advisement from the RCS chamber; administrative appeal is available for discriminatory refusals.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Blocked Escrow Account Opening and Capital Deposit at a Luxembourg Credit Institution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution duly licensed by the CSSF (e.g., Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État – BCEE, BIL, BNP Paribas Luxembourg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open an account in the name of the company in formation; subscribe the EUR 12,000 share capital and pay in at least 20% of each share nominal value plus the full share premium; obtain the bank's blocked-account certificate (attestation de blocage) listing the account holder, the paid-in amount, and the funds' release condition (registration of the future company).
required_dossiers: Draft project of articles of association (projet de statuts)
Passports or national IDs of shareholders, managers and ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs)
Recent proof of residential address (utility bill or lease)
AML/KYC questionnaire and source-of-funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of prolonged KYC review, provide supplemental bank statements and explain the lawful commercial source; escalate to the bank's client-relationship committee; if the bank refuses, select another CSSF-licensed credit institution without losing the name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Signature of Incorporation Deed Before a Luxembourg Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary (Notaire), member of the Chambre des Notaires du Luxembourg
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver the draft statutes, capital certificate, name reservation certificate and KYC files to the notary; if a shareholder or manager cannot attend in person, execute a notarized or apostilled power of attorney; sign the authentic instrument; the notary verifies the legality of the statutes and remains responsible for subsequent registration filings.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of association validated by counsel
Blocked-capital certificate issued by the bank (attestation de blocage)
Name reservation certificate
Apostilled and translated powers of attorney and passports for non-resident signatories
Notary's AML and beneficial-owner declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises a legal defect, amend the statutes by a supplementary clause and re-sign a rectification deed; if the deed is defective, obtain a judicial rectification ruling before the District Court without starting the process anew.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RCS (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés) via the electronic LBR platform; the notary files the deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The notary transmits the incorporation deed and Form C exclusively through the RCS electronic portal within one month of the notarial signature; following data verification, the RCS allocates a registration number and extracts are issued; the extract is published in the RESA electronic gazette, which confers legal opposability towards third parties.
required_dossiers: Authentic notarial deed of incorporation
RCS electronic filing form (Formulaire C) digitally signed by the notary or representative
UBO register declaration (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs – RBE)
Bank certificate and any auditor's report on in-kind contributions if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS objects to the filing, correct the requested data within the statutory time frame (generally three months); if the company is not registered, the notary files a corrective statement or initiates a judicial proceeding to compel registration under Articles 17 et seq. of the Law of 19 December 2002.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VAT, EORI, Social Security and Municipal Premises Formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AED-TVA), Administration des douanes et accises (Customs), Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS) and the competent municipal administration (commune)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the VAT application to the AED-TVA and obtain a VAT number (numéro de TVA) for intra-community and export invoices; apply for an EORI (Economic Operators Registration and Identification) number with Customs for imports of liquidation lots; register as an employer with the CCSS within eight days of hiring staff; notify the commune of the commercial occupancy and obtain the lease-related municipal authorization (permis d'exploitation) for the storage premises.
required_dossiers: RCS registration extract (extrait)
Certified copy of the notarial deed
Lease or property title for the registered office and warehouse
Manager identity document
AED-TVA application (form 640), Customs EORI form, CCSS employer declaration, municipal building occupancy form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AED-TVA queries the VAT number, submit the explanatory cover letter and certificate of residence; for EORI refusals, appeal to the Customs director; for municipal refusal, present a building-maintenance and fire-safety file before the local building inspectorate.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of the Economy (Ministère de l'Économie) – General Directorate for SMEs and Business Regulation, assisted by the Luxembourg Business Registers for electronic licensing workflows
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'établissement (Business Establishment Permit) – statutorily not required for off-price wholesale liquidation trading under Article 7-1 of the amended Law of 2 September 2011 on the freedom of establishment; permit obligations are only triggered for crafts, foodstuffs, transport or other regulated trades

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement (Luxembourg Environmental Protection Agency, within the Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Biodiversity)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a full EIA for pure wholesale warehousing up to 1,500 m² of storage area; storage facilities above this threshold fall under Class 3 (declaration) or Class 2 (authorization) under the consolidated Law of 1 August 2018 on pollution prevention and integrated permitting
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater to municipal sewers must respect by-law parameters (max. temperature 30°C, pH 6-10, BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L, COD ≤ 600 mg/L, TSS ≤ 350 mg/L); no VOC offset-printing or dry-cleaning emissions for apparel re-packaging; packaging waste recovery via Valorlux and compliance with the Luxembourg Packaging Waste Regulation of 21 March 2017; energy audit obligations under the Law of 23 November 2022 if applicable thresholds are reached

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance by the Corps grand-ducal d'incendie et de secours (CGDIS) for any storage occupancy exceeding 1,200 m³, including emergency-exit and extinguisher system approval; occupational safety registration and risk-assessment review by the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM); structural load and building-use clearance (permis d'exploitation) from the competent municipal building department before warehousing operations commence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for income/corporate taxes; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AED) for VAT and registration duties; official portal: guichet.lu / myguichet.lu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a SARL, file incorporation and registration with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) through MyGuichet; obtain the RCS matricule and the Minister of Economy establishment authorization if required. For VAT, submit the Luxembourg VAT registration application using Form 563 to the AED; the AED issues the Luxembourg VAT identification number. A foreign entity without a Luxembourg permanent establishment but making taxable supplies in Luxembourg must register for VAT without benefiting from the domestic EUR 35,000 small-enterprise threshold; non-residents with no EU establishment may be required to appoint a VAT representative.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box; SARL is automatically opaque. Elective fiscal unity (tax consolidation) under LIR Art. 164bis for 95%-owned Luxembourg resident companies for CIT and municipal business tax; elective VAT grouping under LVA Art. 60; hybrid mismatch anti-avoidance rules under ATAD apply and no elective hybrid-mismatch regime is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover for established Luxembourg small businesses (optional registration); no threshold for non-established foreign suppliers—any Luxembourg taxable supply or intra-EU acquisition triggering local VAT requires registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or continuous transaction controls; no digital stamping mandate. E-invoicing is mandatory for B2G supplies to Luxembourg public entities via Peppol; domestic B2B e-invoicing is optional if accepted by the counterparty; VAT returns and recapitulative statements are filed electronically via MyGuichet with audit-readiness of accounting records and SAF-T data.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods physically leaving the EU to non-EU destinations are zero-rated under Luxembourg VAT law. Eligibility requires that the VAT-registered supplier makes the supply, the goods are exported by the supplier or on its instructions, and the supplier holds contemporaneous transport and customs evidence proving removal from the EU. Intra-EU supplies to VAT-registered customers may also be zero-rated with valid EU VAT identification evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic export data/exit notification)
Bill of Lading or other transport evidence (air waybill, CMR, courier track-and-trace)
Commercial invoice, packing list, and inward remittance certificate/payment receipt
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Luxembourg tax authorities scrutinize export files; failure to maintain the required export and payment evidence triggers reversal of zero-rating, assessment of VAT at 17%, late-interest accrual, and penalties up to 100% of the evaded tax for fraudulent concealment; criminal sanctions may also apply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), acting within the Eurosystem of the European Central Bank (ECB); banking prudential and AML/CFT supervision of credit institutions is exercised by the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF), while the Cellule de Renseignements Financiers (CRF) acts as the Luxembourg financial intelligence unit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible. Luxembourg maintains no exchange controls on either current-account or capital-account transactions, as guaranteed by Articles 63 to 66 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union and Council Directive 88/361/EEC of 24 June 1988. For the LU_SARL, there are no exchange-approval requirements for inbound equity injections, outbound trade settlements, dividend distributions, or loan repayments. Profit remittance is operationally unrestricted; the sole fiscal impediment is the Luxembourg dividend withholding tax of 15%, which is reduced to 0% for corporate shareholders meeting the conditions of the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive, or mitigated under an applicable double tax treaty, provided the beneficial ownership file is documented. Full current- and capital-account liberalisation applies, and no separate foreign-investment licence or central bank permit is triggered by the wholesale apparel liquidation activity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender, repatriation, or mandatory conversion obligations exist in Luxembourg. Export proceeds from the liquidation of branded overstock apparel into non-EU markets may be credited in full to EUR-denominated or foreign-currency bank accounts, retained abroad, or converted freely, with no statutory timeline and no minimum conversion ratio. The only compliance burden is indirect: the Luxembourg credit institution must report cross-border payment data to the BCL for euro-area balance-of-payments statistics; the SARL itself is not required to file any export-proceeds declaration or central bank form.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE - Spuerkeess)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account for SARL en formation and multi-currency operational current account with EUR/USD clearing capacity
Capital Escrow Account (share-capital blocking attestation) and operational current account with documentary trade finance and supply-chain support
Operational current account, import/export settlement account, and revolving trade facility for off-price procurement and liquidation receivables
Operational current account and treasury deposit account for the wholesale trading treasury, with private-bank risk appetite

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium as an ancillary payment rail and Low as the sole treasury anchor. An EU-authorised electronic money institution passporting into Luxembourg, or a Luxembourg-licensed EMI under PSD2, can cost-effectively run SEPA instant transfers, virtual IBANs, card acceptance, and lighter receivables collection for the apparel trading operation. Legal constraints: an EMI is neither a credit institution nor a deposit taker; it cannot hold the SARL's initial share-capital escrow for the notarial deed, cannot grant overdrafts or trade credit, and is not covered by the Luxembourg deposit-guarantee scheme. Most EMIs also lack a full SWIFT MT103 correspondent network and cannot provide documentary letters of credit or cross-currency treasury desks. Conclusion: retain one Tier-1 Luxembourg bank as the primary treasury and clearing anchor and use an EMI only for niche receivables collection in EU markets.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, the directors and ultimate beneficial owners of the LU_SARL must complete an in-person or secured remote video interview with the bank's relationship manager and compliance officer before account activation. Luxembourg AML legislation, notably the Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing as amended, requires identification of legal entities and their beneficial owners through reliable independent sources; for a newly incorporated non-listed SARL, the bank will normally demand a physical UBO meeting at the bank's premises or at a notary, or equivalently an advanced video-identification procedure approved by the bank's internal compliance policy and conforming to CSSF circular guidance. For non-resident UBOs using holding structures, physical or videographic validation of the passport, address, and corporate authority is mandatory; remote opening without any interview is not available for this entity profile.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Off-price invoicing materially below official brand wholesale levels, raising counterfeit or grey-market suspicion
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Authenticity certificate and overstock disposal or buy-back agreement with the brand owner or its authorised liquidator; supplier KYB/KYS file; inventory schedule with stock-keeping-unit breakdown, quality grades, and discount formulas; customs SAD declarations; warehouse receipt and transport documents; final invoice-to-goods reconciliation table.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner obscured by a multi-tier foreign holding chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete corporate ownership scheme from the SARL up to the ultimate natural persons; RBE excerpt from the Luxembourg Register of Beneficial Owners; notarially certified share register and UBO declarations of intermediate entities; director authorisation resolutions; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds documentation for the share capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value sporadic SWIFT inflows from distressed-brand sellers or liquidation counterparties in transit or high-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Zero-match sanctions and PEP screening outputs; counterparty KYB packages comprising registry extracts, audited financial statements, and bank references; invoice-to-payment-to-bill-of-lading matching reports; customs broker reports; independent transport and insurance certificates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large upfront capital injection or shareholder loan financing the acquisition of a liquidation portfolio
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder resolution and signed loan or equity subscription agreement; notarised blocking certificate from the receiving bank; audited parent-company financial statements; 12-month cash-flow forecast tracing fund deployment into specific overstock purchases; VAT and customs treatment memoranda.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between declared business scope, payment flows, and substance documents
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial substance file including lease agreement for the Luxembourg registered office, payroll records and director CVs, board meeting minutes, procurement and sales correspondence, warehouse and inventory records, and a detailed margin and tariff analysis explaining the liquidation-trading model.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing: the founding shareholder or parent entity opens a SWIFT MT103 wire to the LU_SARL's blocked capital account at the Luxembourg credit institution before notarial incorporation; the payment order must state the purpose as equity contribution to share capital using the international purpose code for direct investment-equity capital, with remittance information referencing the SARL incorporation file; the minimum statutory share capital of EUR 12,000 for the SARL must be fully subscribed and paid in, with the notary obtaining a bank blocking certificate confirming availability of funds; after the deed is executed and the entity is registered with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register, the blocked account is released and converted into an operational current account. For shareholder loans, use SWIFT MT103 with a purpose code reflecting intercompany financing, supported by the loan agreement, transfer-pricing documentation, and an arm's-length interest schedule; no central bank approval is required and no exchange-control filing applies.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For EU sellers and settlement currency in EUR: use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer with the ISO 11649 RF creditor reference; for non-EU counterparties in USD, GBP, CHF, TRY, or other currencies: use SWIFT MT103 with a clear invoice reference, full beneficiary bank details, and sanctions-screening evidence; where the apparel liquidation seller demands conditional payment security, issue an irrevocable documentary letter of credit under UCP 600 via SWIFT MT700 with the necessary transport and inspection documents, or use a standby letter of credit via MT760 as a performance guarantee; documentary collection (documents against payment or documents against acceptance) is viable for lower-risk bulk overstock purchases; for USD-denominated ACH exposure from sale proceeds in the United States, the Luxembourg bank will execute the receipt through its US correspondent bank and convert into EUR by spot transaction, while the SARL's own disbursements remain primarily SWIFT MT103.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards in EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CHF, and EUR/TRY to hedge forecasted liquidation receivables and supplier payables, documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement or short-form confirmation

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for non-convertible procurement currencies including PKR, BDT, INR, EGP, and THB, cash-settled in EUR or USD, used where the underlying currency cannot be physically delivered
FX swaps and forward rollovers for liquidity bridging between EUR receipts and USD payables in the apparel liquidation cycle
Plain vanilla FX options (EUR puts and calls) to protect the treasury against adverse exchange movements in major liquidation contracts and purchase tenders

Cross-currency swaps for shareholder loans or monetised trade receivables where principal and interest are exchanged between EUR and USD, executed under an ISDA Master Agreement with a Credit Support Annex; all instruments are freely permissible under Luxembourg law, Eurosystem membership, and EU free-movement-of-capital rules, provided the SARL documents a genuine commercial hedging rationale and complies with applicable EMIR counterparty classification, trade reporting, and MiFID II professional-client confirmation.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 17% national CIT + 7% solidarity surcharge (1.19%) + Luxembourg City municipal business tax (6.75%) = aggregate headline statutory rate of 24.94% for tax year 2024; outside Luxembourg City the municipal multiplier varies typically between 6.65% and 11.05%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Luxembourg does not grant statutory tax holidays, but provides a preferential IP box (80% exemption on qualifying IP income, aggregate effective rate about 4.99%), a participation exemption on dividends and capital gains from qualifying shareholdings (minimum 10% interest or EUR 6,000,000 acquisition cost held for 12 months), an investment tax credit of 7% to 13% on eligible tangible investments, and an innovation credit for qualifying research and development expenditure.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (indefinite carryforward period, no carryback); however, annual utilization is capped at EUR 5,000,000 of taxable income plus 70% of taxable income exceeding EUR 5,000,000, and loss carryforward is forfeited if the corporation substantially changes its business activity within the meaning of article 114bis LIR.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Luxembourg corporate income tax return Form No. 600 (Déclaration pour l'impôt sur le revenu des collectivités), covering CIT, solidarity surcharge, municipal business tax and net wealth tax; filed electronically through the Administration des contributions directes (ACD) via the MyGuichet.lu e-filing portal (eTax / eSGS), mandatory for all resident SARLs and Luxembourg branches of non-resident companies.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; the tax period normally coincides with the SARL's financial year, unless a different tax year is expressly approved by the ACD.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return must be filed within five months after the close of the financial year (31 May for a calendar-year SARL); the ACD generally grants an automatic extension to 31 December of the following year in practice, and additional extensions must be requested electronically before the expiry of the deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company legal name, SARL form, registered office address in Luxembourg, RCS (Luxembourg business register) number, VAT identification number and ACD tax file number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident company operating through a Luxembourg branch or permanent establishment must insert the branch's local address, the Luxembourg VAT number and the ACD tax reference, and must attach the parent company's certificate of existence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B — Financial statements and tax reconciliation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Attach the annual accounts prepared under Luxembourg GAAP (balance sheet, profit and loss account, notes); reconcile accounting profit to taxable income by adding back non-deductible expenses (CIT itself, certain penalties, excessive interest) and deducting exempt income (participation-exempt dividends and gains, 80% IP income).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Luxembourg PE must present separate accounts for the branch activity, with transfer pricing adjustments documented for intercompany transactions with the foreign head office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section C — Depreciation, provisions and inventory
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of tax depreciation of fixed assets (linear or declining balance per ACD tables) and tax provisions; inventory of off-price overstock garments may be written down to net realizable value, and doubtful trade receivables may be provisioned if documented.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fixed assets of the PE are depreciated according to Luxembourg tax tables; inventory located in Luxembourg is valued on the same prudent commercial basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section D — Tax losses carried forward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of opening and closing loss carryforward, current-year usage and any forfeiture; utilization is limited to EUR 5,000,000 plus 70% of the taxable income exceeding EUR 5,000,000; continuity of the same commercial activity must be demonstrated.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only losses generated by the Luxembourg PE are available; foreign head-office losses are not deductible in Luxembourg.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Determination of the IBT taxable base and application of the municipal multiplier of the commune where the SARL's registered office or PE is located (Luxembourg City 6.75%).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PE is subject to IBT in the commune where the fixed place of business is situated; use that commune's multiplier and file the related IBT annex in Form 600.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of taxable net wealth (assets minus liabilities, after the exempt amount) at 0.5% per year, with a minimum net wealth tax of EUR 4,815 for 2024 companies with a balance sheet total above EUR 350,000; minimum of EUR 535 for dormant micro-companies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE's Luxembourg-situs assets are subject to NWT; the applicable DTA may reduce the rate but the minimum NWT remains enforceable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section G — CIT, solidarity surcharge and advance payments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of CIT at 17%, solidarity surcharge at 7% of CIT, deduction of quarterly prepayments already made, and declaration of the remaining balance due or refund claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The branch itself files quarterly prepayments under its Luxembourg tax reference; prepayments made by the foreign head office do not belong to the PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section H — Declaration, signature and annexes
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Electronic declaration signed by the authorized director (gérant) attesting accuracy; annexes include annual accounts, directors' report, tax elections and any requests for administrative rulings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A resident tax representative may sign for the PE; the representative's name, address and professional license number must be identified.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a statutory reminder (mise en demeure), possible taxation by default (imposition d'office) on the ACD's own estimated basis, a late-filing surcharge of up to 10% of the assessed tax, default interest of 0.6% per commenced month, and administrative fines between EUR 250 and EUR 2,500 for breach of the mandatory e-filing obligation; unpaid taxes may be collected through garnishment and seizure of bank accounts and inventory.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% statutory withholding tax on dividends and other profit distributions paid by a Luxembourg SARL, unless reduced by a double tax agreement or eliminated under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive (0% for an EU resident corporate shareholder holding at least 10% for an uninterrupted 12-month period and satisfying the anti-abuse substance test); under the Luxembourg-China DTA currently in force the rate is capped at 5% for a beneficial owner holding at least 25% of the capital and 10% otherwise.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief: (1) obtain a tax residence certificate (TRC) from the foreign tax authority for the year of distribution (for a Chinese corporate parent, issue the Chinese TRC and, where required, a beneficial-ownership self-declaration); (2) the Luxembourg paying SARL must obtain the TRC and a completed limitation-of-benefits declaration before payment to withhold at the treaty rate; (3) for the 0% EU regime, file the standard ACD attestation form (attestation d'exonération de retenue à la source) with evidence of the 10% shareholding and 12-month holding period; (4) if treaty relief is not granted at source, the non-resident shareholder must file a refund claim with the ACD within five years of payment, annexing the dividend voucher, TRC and proof of underlying substance; (5) all documentation must be retained by the SARL for six years for audit purposes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Luxembourg imposes no statutory withholding tax on arm's-length interest or royalty payments made by a resident SARL to non-residents; the EU Interest and Royalties Directive (2003/49/EC) confirms 0% for qualifying associated EU companies, and most Luxembourg DTAs, including the Luxembourg-China treaty, eliminate or reduce these taxes; anti-abuse warning: interest on profit-participating loans and any remuneration economically equivalent to a dividend may be recharacterized as a dividend distribution and trigger the 15% withholding tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Luxembourg has no statutory Local File or Master File filing threshold for ordinary taxpayers; however, multinational groups with consolidated group revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000 must file Country-by-Country notifications and returns with the ACD; for all related-party transactions, contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation (Local File and Master File following the OECD TP Guidelines and the EU Transfer Pricing Documentation standard) is required in practice to avoid reversal of the burden of proof in a tax audit.
